lines.en: label cafe25:
scene gooddayredux1
Another morning at the cafe means another chance to be poisoned by an overly creative and mildly intimidating barista.
lines.zh: 又一个在咖啡馆的早晨，意味着又一次被一位过于有创造力、又有点吓人的咖啡师下毒的机会。

lines.en: But upon entering, I realize that Rin isn’t behind the counter.
lines.zh: 但一进门，我就发现 Rin 不在柜台后面。

lines.en: In fact, {i}no one{/i} is behind the counter.
lines.zh: 事实上，柜台后面{i}一个人{/i}都没有。

lines.en: No one is in the cafe at all...
lines.zh: 咖啡馆里一个人都没有……

lines.en: What exactly is going on here?
lines.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Hey, {i}loser.{/i} Can’t you read?
lines.zh: : 嘿，{i}输家{/i}。你不识字吗？

lines.en: scene gooddayredux2
: What's going on? Where is everyone? Also, don't call me a loser.
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？大家都去哪儿了？还有，别叫我输家。

lines.en: : I'll call you whatever I want to call you, loser. And what, was the big sign on the door saying we're closed today not enough to tip you off?
lines.zh: : 我想叫你什么就叫你什么，输家。怎么，门上那块写着今天休息的大牌子还不够让你明白吗？

lines.en: : Why are you closed? It's just a random weekend.
lines.zh: : 你们为什么休息？就一个普通的周末啊。

lines.en: : Also, why are you here if you're closed? And why are you wearing your casual clothes?
lines.zh: : 还有，既然休息你为什么在这儿？你为什么穿着便服？

lines.en: : Damn, Sensei. Didn't realize we were gonna be playing twenty questions today. You know you can just ask me what color my underwear is, right? You don't have to beat around the bush.
lines.zh: : 靠，Sensei。没想到今天要玩二十个问题啊。你知道你可以直接问我内裤是什么颜色的吧？不用绕弯子。

lines.en: : Wait, I can?
lines.zh: : 等等，我可以？

lines.en: scene gooddayredux3
: No. But I thought I'd be a good friend and give you some hope since I can't give you any coffee today.
lines.zh: : 不行。不过我觉得当个好朋友，给你点希望也好，毕竟今天我给不了你咖啡。

lines.en: : What good is hope if you're just going to take it away immediately?
lines.zh: : 希望刚给就被拿走，那有什么意义？

lines.en: : I don't know, homie. Ask the Rin floatin' around in your fantasies later. She'll probs know better than I do.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，homie。回头去问你幻想里飘着的那个 Rin 吧。她大概比我知道得多。

lines.en: : ...Homie?
lines.zh: : ……homie？

lines.en: : Sorry. I meant to say Sensei. I mix those two words up all the time.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我想说的是 Sensei。这两个词我老是搞混。

lines.en: : I feel like that would be mildly problematic if you had literally anyone else as a teacher.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，你要是换了别的任何人当老师，这大概都会有点麻烦。

lines.en: : Well, I guess I'm lucky I ended up with you then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那我想，最后摊上你我还挺幸运的，是吧？

lines.en: : I guess so...
lines.zh: : 大概是吧……

lines.en: : For real, though. Why are you closed?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。你们为什么休息？

lines.en: scene gooddayredux4
: Repairs or something, I think. Wasn't really informed of the full details.
lines.zh: : 好像是维修什么的。具体细节我也没被告知。

lines.en: : All I know is that Haruka needed somebody to come in and tidy stuff up before the repair people came and I just happened to have some extra time on my hands this morning.
lines.zh: : 我只知道 Haruka 需要有人在维修工来之前过来收拾一下，而我今天早上刚好有空。

lines.en: scene gooddayredux3
: Lucky for you, I've got even {i}more{/i} spare time now since I've already finished up everything that needed to be done.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，既然该干的活我都干完了，现在我{i}更{/i}有空了。

lines.en: : Do you mean we're actually going to spend the morning together with you {i}not{/i} in that funny visor?
lines.zh: : 你是说，我们真的可以一起过这个早上，而你{i}不{/i}戴那个滑稽的遮阳帽？

lines.en: scene gooddayredux5
: Woah, there! What did my visor ever do to you? You can't just talk crap on it like that.
lines.zh: : 哇，等等！我的遮阳帽招你惹你了？你不能就这么说它坏话。

lines.en: : I blame the lack of caffeine. So, in a roundabout sort of way, it's actually your fault I said that.
lines.zh: : 都怪没有咖啡因。所以绕了一圈，我这么说其实还是你的错。

lines.en: scene gooddayredux6
: Well, I don't follow that logic at all. But if you want coffee, we can get some on the way. There are plenty of cafes between here and the urban district.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我完全没听懂这逻辑。不过你想喝咖啡的话，我们可以在路上买。从这儿到市区一带有的是咖啡馆。

lines.en: : What? We're going all the way over there?
lines.zh: : 什么？我们要一路走到那儿去？

lines.en: scene gooddayredux2
: Hell yeah, man. I wanna walk around the city.
lines.zh: : 那当然，老兄。我想在城里走走。

lines.en: : I haven’t been getting out much lately and I need some exercise before my limbs fall off or stop working or something.
lines.zh: : 我最近都不怎么出门，需要在我的四肢掉下来或者罢工之前运动一下。

lines.en: : Neither of those things happen due to lack of exercise but sure, I guess I’ll walk around with you.
lines.zh: : 这两件事都不会因为缺乏运动而发生，不过好吧，我陪你走走。

lines.en: : Neat! Well, I'm ready whenever you are.
lines.zh: : 太好了！那么你准备好了我就随时可以出发。

lines.en: : Oh, and the answer was black, by the way.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，答案是黑色，顺便说一句。

lines.en: : The answer to- oh.
lines.zh: : 什么答案——哦。

lines.en: scene gooddayredux3
: You're welcome, homie.
lines.zh: : 不客气，homie。

lines.en: scene black
scene gooddayredux7
Rin and I spend some time walking around the more...{i}metropolitan{/i} section of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 我和 Rin 花了一些时间在 Kumon-mi 更……{i}大都会{/i}的那一片逛。

lines.en: It's not one I venture too often, so I wind up sticking close to her as she leads us...well, wherever she's in the mood to lead us, I guess.
lines.zh: 我不常涉足那一带，所以我一路紧跟着她，让她带我们去……嗯，她想带我们去哪儿就去哪儿吧。

lines.en: So far, that has equated to nothing but anime stores where she proceeded to freak out about the prices of things before getting upset and leaving.
lines.zh: 到目前为止，这就等于逛了一家又一家的动画店，而她每次都是对着价格抓狂一番，然后闷闷不乐地走出来。

lines.en: This has happened five times now and I still do not have any coffee.
lines.zh: 这样已经五次了，而我依然没喝上咖啡。

lines.en: scene gooddayredux8
: Who shoved a stick up your butt, Mr. Crankypants?
lines.zh: : 谁把棍子塞你屁股里了，暴躁先生？

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : You've barely said anything since we left the cafe. Am I {i}boring{/i} you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我们从咖啡馆出来之后你就几乎没说过话。我{i}闷到{/i}你了，Sensei？

lines.en: : Or are you just a little embarrassed to be walking around with a moderately cute girl?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你只是跟一个中等可爱的女孩走在一起有点不好意思？

lines.en: : I'd rank you several levels above moderate, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我会把你排在「中等」之上好几级，Rin。

lines.en: : Why, that's the nicest thing anyone has ever said to me. Thank you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这是别人跟我说过最好听的话了。谢谢你，Sensei。

lines.en: : You're welcome. Can I get coffee now?
lines.zh: : 不客气。我现在能喝咖啡了吗？

lines.en: scene gooddayredux9
: Oh, crap! I totally forgot!
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了！我完全忘了！

lines.en: : Why didn’t you say anything sooner?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么不早点说？！

lines.en: : I even dragged you into that one anime store that you were totally uninterested in!
lines.zh: : 我还把你拽进了那家你根本不感兴趣的动画店！

lines.en: : It was five.
lines.zh: : 是五家。

lines.en: : Five?! Why did you let me carry on for so long?!
lines.zh: : 五家？！你为什么让我一个人闹腾那么久？！

lines.en: scene gooddayredux10
: You need to be more open about your needs, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你得把自己的需求说得更明白一点，Sensei。

lines.en: : If this relationship is ever going to work, we're going to have to keep each other in check.
lines.zh: : 如果这段关系要长久，我们就得互相看着点。

lines.en: : Using the word {i}relationship{/i} makes it sound like we're more than just friends, you know.
lines.zh: : 用{i}关系{/i}这个词，听起来我们就不只是朋友了，你知道的。

lines.en: scene gooddayredux11
: But...we are, aren't we?
lines.zh: : 可是……我们本来就不只是朋友吧？

lines.en: Rin pauses for a moment as her face begins to redden and her eyes get locked on mine.
lines.zh: Rin 顿了一下，脸开始泛红，眼睛锁在了我身上。

lines.en: I know this face. She’s about to confess her-
lines.zh: 我认识这个表情。她要表白她的——

lines.en: scene gooddayredux12
: Homies.
lines.zh: : Homies。

lines.en: : Why do you keep saying that all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然老说这个词？

lines.en: : What?! You said we're just friends, but we're so much more than that! Homies are like...four steps above friends.
lines.zh: : 什么？！你说我们只是朋友，可我们比那可多得多！Homie 大概比朋友高……四级。

lines.en: : But I guess you probs wouldn't know that since you're such a friggin' boomer.
lines.zh: : 不过我想你大概不懂，毕竟你是个他妈的老古董。

lines.en: : Why am I being bullied today? All I wanted was coffee.
lines.zh: : 我今天为什么老被欺负？我只是想喝杯咖啡而已。

lines.en: : And all I want is a cute gyaru girlfriend with fishnets and a cell phone addiction.
lines.zh: : 而我想要的，是一个穿渔网袜、有手机依赖症的可爱辣妹女朋友。

lines.en: : I guess we can't always get what we want, though, can we?...
lines.zh: : 我想我们不可能总能如愿以偿吧，对吧？……

lines.en: scene gooddayredux8
: Buuuuut...since I’m the greatest and coolest homie in the entire world, we can stop for coffee at the next cafe we see.
lines.zh: : 不——过……既然我是全世界最棒最酷的 homie，我们可以在看到的下一家咖啡馆停下来喝一杯。

lines.en: : And I just so happen to know a pretty good place right around the corner and-
lines.zh: : 而我刚好知道拐角处有一家挺不错的，而且——

lines.en: scene gooddayredux13
: Ah-!
Rin suddenly stops walking when something catches her attention.
lines.zh: Rin 突然停下脚步，有什么东西吸引了她的注意。

lines.en: : Holy shit.
lines.zh: : 我操。

lines.en: : Holy shit. Holy shit. Holy shit.
lines.zh: : 我操。我操。我操。

lines.en: : What? What's wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？出什么事了？
: 我们……

lines.en: : We have been graced by the presence of an angel...
lines.zh: : 我们被一位天使的降临所庇佑了……

lines.en: scene omgkaori1
Rin lunges forward toward the {i}angel{/i} who is none other than the Queen of Spiders herself- Kaori.
lines.zh: Rin 朝那位{i}天使{/i}扑了过去——而那不是别人，正是蜘蛛女王本人——Kaori。

lines.en: I'm surprised to see this sort of reaction out of her, though.
lines.zh: 不过她这种反应让我有点意外。

lines.en: I get that Rin is {i}incredibly{/i} attracted to girls, but the way she's acting toward Kaori makes it seem like-
lines.zh: 我知道 Rin 对女孩子{i}极其{/i}有感觉，可她对 Kaori 这副样子，看起来像是——

lines.en: : Oh my god! No friggin’ way! Kaori?! Is that really you?!
lines.zh: : 我的天！不会吧！Kaori？！真的是你吗？！

lines.en: : H-How do you know my name?! Who are you?!
lines.zh: : 你、你怎么知道我的名字？！你是谁？！

lines.en: : Identify yourself!
lines.zh: : 报上名来！

lines.en: : Uhh...what’s going on here, exactly?
lines.zh: : 呃……这到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene omgkaori2
: Hamburger Man! Help! I am under attack!
lines.zh: : 汉堡侠！救命！我遭到袭击了！

lines.en: scene omgkaori3
: ...Hamburger Man?
lines.zh: : ……汉堡侠？

lines.en: : It’s better to not ask.
lines.zh: : 别问比较好。

lines.en: : How are you doing, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你最近怎么样，Kaori？

lines.en: : Horrible! I require immediate assistance and will pay you in meat for the favors you will perform today!
lines.zh: : 糟透了！我需要立刻得到援助，我会用肉来偿付你今天要为我做的事！

lines.en: : And what exactly do you need immediate assistance with? You’re not actually under attack.
lines.zh: : 你具体需要什么紧急援助？你其实并没有遭到袭击。

lines.en: scene omgkaori4
: I’m...not under attack?
lines.zh: : 我……没遭到袭击？

lines.en: : Of course not. Rin's just a mildly annoying, extraordinarily horny teenager.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。Rin 只是个有点烦人、又极其饥渴的青少年。

lines.en: : It's true. I really am.
lines.zh: : 是真的。我确实是。

lines.en: : Rin, would you mind explaining how you know Kaori? Because she...definitely does not seem like she knows you.
lines.zh: : Rin，你能解释一下你怎么认识 Kaori 的吗？因为她……显然看起来不认识你。

lines.en: : Was she your waitress before or something?
lines.zh: : 她以前是你服务过的服务员之类的？

lines.en: scene omgkaori5
: Waitress? Are you kidding? She’s like, a totally famous Instagram model!
lines.zh: : 服务员？你在开玩笑吗？她可是，超有名的 Instagram 模特！

lines.en: : A...what?
lines.zh: : 什么……什么？

lines.en: : What is this ‘instant gram’ you speak of, extraordinarily aroused girl? Explain yourself.
lines.zh: : 你说的这个「即时格拉姆」是什么，极度亢奋的女孩？给我解释清楚。

lines.en: scene omgkaori6
: Sensei, remind me to show you her page later! She takes tons of super cute pictures of all kinds of stuff.
lines.zh: : Sensei，提醒我回头给你看她的主页！她拍了一堆各种各样的超可爱照片。

lines.en: : I'm good. Not really big on social media.
lines.zh: : 算了。我不怎么玩社交媒体。

lines.en: scene omgkaori7
: Media can talk?!
lines.zh: : 媒体会说话？！

lines.en: : You sure? There's a bunch of risque underwear pics on there that you'll be missing out on...
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？那儿可有一堆大胆的内衣照，你会错过的……

lines.en: : My interest in this conversation has suddenly skyrocketed.
lines.zh: : 我对这段对话的兴趣突然飙升了。

lines.en: : What does that strange word mean? {i}Risque?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那个奇怪的词是什么意思？{i}Risque？{/i}

lines.en: : It means sexy.
lines.zh: : 是性感的意思。

lines.en: : Sexy?! Tell me it is not so, Hamburger Man!
lines.zh: : 性感？！告诉我不是这样，汉堡侠！

lines.en: : Rin, how risque are these photos exactly?
lines.zh: : Rin，那些照片到底有多「大胆」？

lines.en: : Why do you not show more concern for my well-being when I am in a clear state of crisis?!
lines.zh: : 为什么在我明显处于危机状态的时候，你一点也不关心我的安危？！

lines.en: : There aren't like, nudes or anything. Just some closeups of her tattoo and a bunch of pictures of her trying on different types of underwear.
lines.zh: : 也没有裸照什么的。就是几张她纹身的近照，还有一堆她试穿各种内衣的照片。

lines.en: : This can not be true! I do not even know what an instant gram is!
lines.zh: : 这不可能！我连什么是即时格拉姆都不知道！

lines.en: : The only pictures I have inserted into the digital world have been for the sake of personal documentation of my journey through this planet!
lines.zh: : 我上传到数字世界里的照片，全都是为了个人记录我在这颗星球上的旅程！

lines.en: scene omgkaori9
: Wait...I kinda feel like you’re being serious right now.
lines.zh: : 等等……我怎么觉得你是认真的。

lines.en: : You haven’t actually been...posting all of those pictures on accident, have you?
lines.zh: : 那些照片你不是……不小心发上去的吧？

lines.en: : Are we really not going to question why she’s been taking pictures in her underwear for ‘personal documentation?’
lines.zh: : 我们真的不去问问她为什么为了「个人记录」拍内衣照吗？

lines.en: scene omgkaori10
: Whose team are you on, Hamburger Man?!
lines.zh: : 你到底站哪边的，汉堡侠？！

lines.en: : I’m on the team that wants to see those pictures.
lines.zh: : 我站想看那些照片的那一边。

lines.en: : Those pictures are not to be seen by the prying eyes of a human male such as yourself!
lines.zh: : 那些照片不是给你这种人类雄性窥视的！

lines.en: scene omgkaori11
: Even if you are a prime mating specimen who I am extraordinarily attracted to!
lines.zh: : 就算你是个我极其有好感的优质交配对象！

lines.en: : Ah-
: What?! What is the reason for this sudden silence?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！为什么突然都沉默了？！

lines.en: : I am not yet familiar with human conversation! Is openly discussing mating rituals not acceptable behavior?!
lines.zh: : 我还不熟悉人类的对话！公开讨论交配仪式是不被接受的行为吗？！

lines.en: scene omgkaori12
: Sensei...I think Kaori wants to...{i}mate with you...{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei……我觉得 Kaori 想……{i}跟你交配……{/i}

lines.en: : I...I said no such thing!
lines.zh: : 我……我可没说过这种话！

lines.en: scene omgkaori13
: Can I...maybe...watch?
lines.zh: : 我能……也许……在旁边看吗？

lines.en: : You may watch nothing! You are already aroused enough! Any more will result in spontaneous combustion!
lines.zh: : 你什么都别想看！你已经够亢奋了！再多一点就会自燃！

lines.en: : I don't mind if you watch, Rin. Kaori and I are ready to mate whenever.
lines.zh: : 我不介意你看，Rin。我和 Kaori 随时准备好交配。

lines.en: scene omgkaori15
: I will not mate with you, Hamburger Man! I have yet to even discover what the instant gram is!
lines.zh: : 我不会跟你交配的，汉堡侠！我连什么是即时格拉姆都还没搞明白！

lines.en: : Too much remains undone! My body is simply not prepared!
lines.zh: : 太多事没做完！我的身体根本还没准备好！

lines.en: : Kaori...wants you...to prepare her body...
lines.zh: : Kaori……想让你……把她的身体准备好……

lines.en: scene omgkaori17
: You should be referred to as the extraordinarily dishonest girl instead! The lies drip from your mouth like water from a leaky faucet!
lines.zh: : 你该改名叫极度不诚实的女孩才对！谎话从你嘴里滴下来，像漏水的水龙头！

lines.en: : Sensei...what will you do?
lines.zh: : Sensei……你要怎么做？

lines.en: menu:
Prepare Kaori’s body
lines.zh: 把 Kaori 的身体准备好

lines.en: $ kaoriprepared = True
: I suppose I’ll have to do what must be d-
lines.zh: : 我想我得做该做的——

lines.en: scene omgkaori18
: You will do no such thing!
lines.zh: : 你不许做那种事！

lines.en: Don’t do that thing
lines.zh: 别做那种事

lines.en: $ kaoriprepared = False
: I’m not sure if she’s ready yet, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我不确定她准备好了没有，Rin……

lines.en: : Maybe...{i}I{/i} can help her get ready then?...
lines.zh: : 那也许……{i}我{/i}能帮她准备好？……

lines.en: scene omgkaori19
: Do not come near me, heathen!
lines.zh: : 别靠近我，异教徒！

lines.en: scene omgkaori20
: Why must so many confusing things happen today of all days?!
lines.zh: : 为什么偏偏是今天，要发生这么多叫人费解的事？！

lines.en: scene omgkaori21
: Is something wrong, Kaori? Are you having a bad day?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗，Kaori？你今天过得很糟？

lines.en: : The worst day. The woman at the pet store would not provide me a furry companion to nurture and call my own!
lines.zh: : 最糟的一天。宠物店的那个女人不肯给我一只毛茸茸的伙伴来养、来当我自己的！

lines.en: : Why not? Did you not have enough money or something?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你钱不够什么的吗？

lines.en: : I have many of the moneys! And yet each attempted transaction was refused!
lines.zh: : 我有很多的钱！可每一次交易尝试都被拒绝了！

lines.en: : There is no justice in this world!
lines.zh: : 这世上没有公道！

lines.en: : Just find an animal outside. There are plenty of them just...wandering around.
lines.zh: : 那就去外面找只动物吧。外面有好多，就……到处乱晃。

lines.en: scene omgkaori22
: But they are so fast and I am so average-speed. I simply can not keep up.
lines.zh: : 可它们跑得那么快，而我只是中等速度。我实在追不上。

lines.en: : I...really don't know what else to tell you, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 我……真不知道还能跟你说什么了，Kaori。

lines.en: scene omgkaori23
: Of course you do, Hamburger Man...
lines.zh: : 你知道的，汉堡侠……

lines.en: : And yet you conceal your vast amounts of human knowledge from me.
lines.zh: : 可你却对我隐瞒了你那海量的人类知识。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I do not trust you.
lines.zh: : 我不信任你。

lines.en: : And I will not mate with you.
lines.zh: : 而且我不会跟你交配。

lines.en: : And I will now leave.
lines.zh: : 我现在要走了。

lines.en: : Good day, humans.
lines.zh: : 日安，人类。

lines.en: scene omgkaori24
: She’s...{i}different{/i} from how I expected her to be.
lines.zh: : 她……跟我想象中的{i}不太一样{/i}。

lines.en: : Yes, Rin.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Rin。

lines.en: : Yes she is.
lines.zh: : 是啊，确实不一样。

lines.en: scene black
Shortly after that, we obtained my normal human coffee and-
lines.zh: 在那之后不久，我们买到了我这普通人类该喝的咖啡，然后——

lines.en: Oh, god damn it.
lines.zh: 哦，该死。

lines.en: Now even I’m beginning to sound like Kaori.
lines.zh: 现在连我都开始说话像 Kaori 了。

lines.en: We bought coffee and then I walked Rin back to the dorm.
lines.zh: 我们买了咖啡，然后我走回宿舍把 Rin 送了回去。

lines.en: The end.
lines.zh: 完。
